name: Plaid
label: Plaid — Plaid API 2020-09-14
description: Official Plaid API 2020-09-14. Docs: https://plaid.com/docs/api/. One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node. No screen-scraping. End-user consent via Plaid Link (this node only creates link_token). access_token is a secret — prefer config, never logs. Sandbox: sandbox.plaid.com. processor_token is for Stripe/Adyen — not bank passwords.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Plaid. Secrets never on this port.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: link_token_create | item_public_token_exchange | accounts_get | transactions_sync | auth_get | identity_get | processor_token_create | trigger. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: Environment
schema.description: sandbox.plaid.com vs production.plaid.com. Substituted into baseUrl as https://{environment}.

schema.label: public_token
schema.description: Request-body parameter `public_token` for operation: item_public_token_exchange. Required by: item_public_token_exchange.

schema.label: access_token
schema.description: Request-body parameter `access_token` for operations: accounts_get, transactions_sync, auth_get, identity_get, processor_token_create. Required by: accounts_get, transactions_sync, auth_get, identity_get, processor_token_create.

schema.label: account_id
schema.description: Request-body parameter `account_id` for operation: processor_token_create. Required by: processor_token_create.

schema.label: processor
schema.description: Request-body parameter `processor` for operation: processor_token_create. Required by: processor_token_create.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: link_token_create | item_public_token_exchange | accounts_get | transactions_sync | auth_get | identity_get | processor_token_create | trigger. Default link_token_create. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Secret
configurationParameters.description: Plaid credential (header Plaid-Secret). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Client Id
configurationParameters.description: Plaid client_id (also send on JSON body). Not a bank password.

configurationParameters.label: Environment
configurationParameters.description: sandbox.plaid.com vs production.plaid.com. Substituted into baseUrl as https://{environment}.
